title: Splitting a work order moves a line that holds an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [WO-1] with two approved lines: [Line-1] (no parts) and [Line-2] holding [Part-A]; [Part-A] set inactive after it was added.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPLIT-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPLIT-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT PART).
  3. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPLIT-UNIT"); click Create.
  4. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  5. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-1].
  6. On [WO-1] click "New Line", Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL SPLIT line 2"), "Save & Close", then "Approve". [Line-2] = that line.
  7. On [Line-2] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  8. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  9. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] has [Line-1] and [Line-2]; [Line-2] holds [Part-A]; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] and tick the checkbox of [Line-2].
  2. Open the bulk-action menu and click "Split work order"; confirm.
  3. Open the new work order. [WO-2] = its number.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The split completes without an inactive-part refusal.
  • Step 3: [WO-2] holds [Line-2] with [Part-A]; [WO-1] keeps [Line-1] only.
